question: What is the substance that causes pulmonary fibrosis by inhalation ?:
analysis: Pulmonary fibrosis can be caused by various substances, including inhaled particles and certain drugs. Paraquat (opa) is a herbicide known to cause lung damage and fibrosis upon inhalation. Silica (opb) is a well-known occupational hazard that can lead to silicosis, a form of pulmonary fibrosis. Bleomycin (opc) is a chemotherapeutic agent that can also cause pulmonary toxicity and fibrosis. Ozone (opd) is an air pollutant that can irritate the lungs but is not typically classified as a direct cause of pulmonary fibrosis. Given the options, silica is the most recognized inhaled substance that leads to pulmonary fibrosis.
